description: This Java class handles successful authentication events in a Spring Security context, generating JWT tokens, including MFA tokens, and clearing authentication attributes from the session.

classes.name: RestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: Handles successful authentication events, generates JWT tokens, manages MFA tokens, and clears session attributes.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Main handler invoked upon successful authentication; generates appropriate JWT tokens and clears auth attributes.

methods.name: createMfaTokenPair
methods.description: Creates an MFA JWT token pair with a configurable lifetime based on MFA settings.

methods.name: clearAuthenticationAttributes
methods.description: Removes temporary authentication data from the session after successful login.
